title: Compressor - constant isentropic efficiency
description: Isentropic compressor: h_ex = h_su + (h_ex_is - h_su)/eta_is with h_ex_is = h(P_ex, s_su); shaft power W = m_dot*(h_ex - h_su). Inputs P_su,T_su,P_ex,m_dot,fluid; outputs h_ex,T_ex,W_dot.
authors: Basile Chaudoir; Elise Neven; Titouan Janod
notes: difficulty=easy; 1:1 equations, no iteration. reference results: yes (docs/source/notebooks/compressor_model_example.ipynb: R1233zd(E) 3.193 bar/331.03 K -> 6.062 bar, eta_is=0.8 gives T_ex=354.293 K and dh=15 357.5 J/kg; reproduced with CoolProp 7.2 - compare dh/T, not absolute h, because the enthalpy reference state differs between CoolProp versions). overlap: trivial block already in CoolSolve refrigeration/rankine examples.

title: Volumetric compressor - semi-empirical (Lemort scroll/screw model)
description: Lemort (2008) semi-empirical model: suction heating (eps-NTU, AU_su_n*(m/m_n)^0.8), internal leakage through throat (A_leak, compressible nozzle), isentropic + isochoric internal compression (built-in volume ratio rv_in), discharge pressure-drop (d_ex), exhaust cooling, mechanical losses (alpha, W_loss0, C_loss) and fictitious wall energy balance (AU_amb). Mode N_rot (m_dot unknown) or m_dot (N_rot unknown). Outputs eta_is, eps_v, W_dot, h_ex, refrigerant charge.
notes: difficulty=medium; already an implicit residual system (4 unknowns T_w,m_dot,h_ex2,P_ex2 in N_rot mode, 3 in m_dot mode) solved by fsolve inside nested multi-start loops -> write all residuals as simultaneous equations, drop retry loops, supply initial guesses+bounds; clamps (C_thr<=300 m/s, h_su2 min/max) are non-smooth; needs rho(s,h) inversion and a two-phase branch at the leakage state. overlap: CoolSolve examples/scroll_compressor.eescode (EES Lemort model) - value = cross-validation, m_dot mode and R1233zd(E) parameter set. reference results: partial (calibrated parameter set in the example; docs notebook output uses an outdated API and is inconsistent - W=2530 W, m_dot=0.1458 kg/s - do not rely on it; no asserted tests). Parameters are experiment-calibrated, not generic.

title: Radial compressor - mean-line model with loss correlations
description: Mean-line (1D) centrifugal compressor: velocity triangles at stations 1-5, rotor losses (incidence, friction, blade loading, clearance, mixing, disc friction, recirculation) and stator losses from correlations; solves for efficiency/pressure ratio at given N_rot and m_dot.
notes: difficulty=hard; geometry-heavy, many station states, nested root-finds/minimisation; class docstring is a copy of the constant-efficiency compressor (does not describe the model). reference results: no. gap: radial-compressor loss-model family is absent from typical EES teaching collections but is a research-grade add-on.

title: Expander - constant isentropic efficiency
description: Isentropic expander: h_ex = h_su - eta_is*(h_su - h_ex_is), h_ex_is = h(P_ex, s_su); power = m_dot*(h_su - h_ex).
authors: Elise Neven; Basile Chaudoir; Marie Peeters
notes: difficulty=easy; 1:1 equations. reference results: no stored numbers (example script only). overlap: trivial block already in CoolSolve ORC/Rankine examples.

title: Volumetric expander - semi-empirical (Lemort scroll/screw expander model)
description: Lemort (2008) semi-empirical expander: supply cooling/heating (eps-NTU), supply pressure-drop (d_su1), internal leakage, isentropic expansion to built-in volume ratio then isochoric (under/over-expansion), exhaust heat exchange, mechanical losses and wall energy balance. Three modes: P_N (P_ex,N_rot known -> m_dot), P_M (P_ex,m_dot -> N_rot), M_N (m_dot,N_rot -> P_ex).
notes: difficulty=medium; small implicit systems (P_N: m_dot,T_w; P_M: T_w; M_N: P_ex,T_w) solved by fsolve with multi-start loops over filling-factor/temperature-ratio guesses -> simultaneous equations with guesses and bounds; the three modes are only a choice of the known variables (comment/uncomment). overlap: CoolSolve examples/expander_module.eescode (EES version). reference results: partial (calibrated parameter sets V_s=71.2 cm3, rv_in=1.7 in the example and ORC off-design example; no asserted values).

title: Two-phase ejector - constant-efficiency sections (Liu & Groll, CO2)
description: Ejector with motive nozzle (eta_m), suction nozzle (eta_s), mixing section (eta_mix) and diffuser (eta_d); homogeneous-equilibrium choked flow via Kornhauser speed of sound; outputs exhaust state and entrainment ratio. Intended for transcritical CO2 refrigeration/heat pumps.
notes: difficulty=hard; nested brentq on choked mass flux and mixing pressure, HEM sound speed, phase-dependent branches. imports labothappy.correlations.properties.void_fraction which does not exist (module lives in correlations/void_fraction/) so the file is currently not importable. reference results: no (paper reference: Liu & Groll 2008 'Analysis of a two phase flow ejector for transcritical CO2 cycle'). gap: ejector cycles are rare in EES teaching collections.

title: Axial turbine - mean-line model with Aungier losses (sCO2), design + map-based off-design
description: Multi-stage axial mean-line turbine: stage velocity triangles, Aungier profile/secondary/clearance/trailing-edge losses, solved for efficiency/power/P_ex; off-design via pre-computed (m_dot,N_rot) maps interpolated with scipy (linear/RBF); design uses fsolve/differential_evolution/PSO. Based on S. Salah thesis on sCO2 axial turbines.
notes: difficulty=hard; 900-line stage class with optimisation/PSO in the loop and pickled maps; only the algebraic loss-model core is translatable. reference results: no. gap: research-grade turbomachinery meanline (not in EES teaching sets) but heavy and unvalidated in-repo.

title: Pump - constant isentropic efficiency
description: Pump with constant isentropic efficiency: h_ex = h_su + (h_ex_is - h_su)/eta_is; power = m_dot*(h_ex - h_su).
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no stored numbers. overlap: trivial block.

title: Pump - manufacturer curves + similarity (affinity) laws, with NPSH
description: Pump from head, isentropic efficiency and NPSHr curves at rated speed, scaled with Q~N, H~N^2; modes P_N (P_su,P_ex,N -> m_dot), P_M (P_su,P_ex,m_dot -> N) and M_N (m_dot,N -> P_ex). Outputs shaft power, outlet enthalpy, NPSHr and out-of-range flag; plot of curves.
notes: difficulty=medium; curves must become lookup tables or polynomial fits (P_M mode inverts head(N) with a scalar root-find -> simply an unknown N); linear extrapolation outside curve range needs explicit handling. reference results: no stored outputs; PDF derivation docs/source/_static/pdf_files/PumpCurveSimilarity.pdf (+PumpSimLaw.pdf) and an example with real curve data. gap: curve-based pump with affinity laws is not in the CoolSolve examples.

title: Valve - isenthalpic expansion
description: Throttling valve: h_ex = h_su with P_ex imposed; outlet temperature/quality from CoolProp. Inputs P_su, T_su, P_ex, fluid; outputs h_ex, T_ex.
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no. overlap: trivial block.

title: Heat exchanger - constant effectiveness (counterflow, enthalpy-based Q_max)
description: Q_max = min(m_H*(h_H,su - h_H(P_H,T_C,su)), m_C*(h_C(P_C,T_H,su) - h_C,su)); Q = eta*Q_max; outlet enthalpies and optional constant pressure drops DP_h, DP_c. Falls back to C_min*(T_H-T_C) for incompressible/failed property calls. Used as recuperator/IHX/gas cooler in cycle examples.
notes: difficulty=easy; explicit equations (no phase-change logic needed because Q_max uses enthalpies). reference results: no stored numbers; self-checks: 0<=eta<=1 and no temperature cross for eta<1 when no pinch. building block for cycle-level models (IHX, recuperator).

title: Heat exchanger - discretised constant effectiveness with minimum pinch
description: Counterflow HX split into n_disc enthalpy segments: effectiveness eta (user maximum) is reduced in 1 % steps until the minimum temperature difference in every segment is >= Pinch_min; Q_max found by a fictive-effectiveness search (internal pinching); equal pressure-drop split. Used as sCO2/CO2 gas heater and recuperators.
notes: difficulty=medium; the effectiveness-decrement while-loop must be re-cast as simultaneous equations: unknown Q, enthalpy profiles h_H[i],h_C[i] (DUPLICATE) and a pinch constraint min_i(T_H[i]-T_C[i]) = Pinch_min (non-smooth min -> smooth min or IF on the active segment). reference results: no stored numbers; doc page has the full procedure (doc quality 3). gap: pinch-limited HX with real-fluid enthalpy profiles (sCO2 recuperators) is poorly covered by EES teaching models.

title: Heat exchanger - constant pinch (evaporator/condenser, sub-cooled/two-phase/superheated zones)
description: Phase-changing HX sized by a given pinch (min. temperature difference) and imposed superheat/subcooling: zone energy balances on the working-fluid side (sc/tp/sh), secondary-fluid temperatures from enthalpy, pinch located at inlet, saturation point or outlet; unknown saturation pressure P_sat found with brentq; optional DP_c/DP_h linear split.
authors: Basile Chaudoir; Elise Neven; Titouan Janod
notes: difficulty=medium; scalar root-find on P_sat -> make P_sat an unknown and the pinch residual an equation; pinch location is the min over up to 3 candidate temperature differences (non-smooth) -> fix location per regime (evaporator: bubble point or cold end, condenser: dew point or hot end) or use IF/smooth min; zone logic uses max(0,.) clamps. reference results: no stored numbers, but the specified pinch is an exact self-check. Core ORC/heat-pump design block; doc page with scheme (SVG). Translated as CSL-0014 hx_constant_pinch (condenser branch only, verified vs the COND_CO2 example; CoolProp CO2 maps to EES R744).

title: Heat exchanger - eps-NTU with plate/pipe geometry (Gnielinski, wall conduction, fouling)
description: UA from series resistances 1/(h_H A) + 1/(h_C A) + t/(k A) + R_f/A with Gnielinski internal-flow Nusselt; C_min, C_r from inlet cp; eps from the flow-arrangement relation (counter, parallel, crossflow mixed/unmixed, shell&tube 1-2/n passes); Q = eps*C_min*(T_H,in - T_C,in).
authors: Basile Chaudoir; Marie Peeters; Elise Neven
notes: difficulty=easy; explicit once UA is known; Gnielinski needs Re/Pr from properties at mean temperature. reference results: yes (indirect) - TESPy tests/test_components/test_ntu_heat_exchanger.py::test_labothappy_reference: water/water counterflow, m_H=0.014 kg/s at 90 C, m_C=0.08 kg/s at 12 C, 4 bar, UA=132.069586 W/K -> Q=3961.9 W, T_H,out=295.54 K, T_C,out=296.98 K (rel. tol 2e-3; cp at inlet). docs bug: rst writes 1/AU as a product of resistances, code (correct) sums them. e_NTU.py counterflow formula is singular at C_r=1.

title: Fin-and-tube cross-flow heat exchanger - finite-volume model (evaporator/condenser)
description: Cell-by-cell finite-volume model of a multi-circuit plate-finned tube coil (geometry after Macchitella et al. 2023, 8-circuit layout): refrigerant-side HTC/DP (Gnielinski, condensation/boiling correlations, Churchill/MSH), air-side fin HTC and fin efficiency, per-cell nonlinear solve, refrigerant charge.
authors: Basile Chaudoir; Samuel Gendebien; Elise Neven
notes: difficulty=hard; per-cell fsolve with circuit topology -> DUPLICATE over cells and circuits gives hundreds of equations plus correlation FUNCTIONs; strong phase-dependent branching. reference results: no stored numbers. gap: air-source evaporator/condenser coil models are valuable for heat-pump work (compare EES 'hx - fem' models).

title: Heat exchanger - generalised moving-boundary (Bell 2015) with geometry, correlations and charge (plate, shell&tube, tube-fin, PCHE)
description: Counterflow moving-boundary algorithm with adaptive cell boundaries at phase changes (any phase configuration), brentq on total Q, per-cell HTC and pressure drop from selectable correlations (plate, Kern/Bell-Delaware, tube-fin, PCHE), void-fraction based refrigerant charge, optional multipass LMTD correction.
notes: difficulty=hard; 3000-line class, variable number of cells decided at run time -> a CoolSolve translation must fix the topology (e.g. plate evaporator: liquid/two-phase/vapour zones on the refrigerant side) and call correlations as FUNCTIONs. reference results: indirect - generic Bell (2015) oracle cases (Water/n-Propane, propane/propane) stored in TESPy tests/test_components/bell2015_five_cases.json can validate a correlation-free MB core. Algorithm by Bell, Quoilin, Georges, Braun, Groll, Horton, Lemort (Appl. Therm. Eng. 79, 2015) - co-authors include S. Quoilin and V. Lemort. Docs: example per geometry.

title: Heat-pipe (thermosyphon) heat exchanger with operating limits
description: Thermosyphon-tube bank HX: external gas-side and internal pool-boiling/condensation thermal resistances, tube-bank pressure drop, ESDU-type operating limits (entrainment, boiling, sonic, dry-out, vapour pressure). Report-based model (DECAGONE heat-pipe project).
notes: difficulty=hard; many nested iterations and limit checks; model described in a PDF report (docs/source/_static/pdf_files/DECAGONE___Heat_Pipes_Report.pdf). reference results: no. niche but unique.

title: Straight pipe - single/two-phase friction pressure drop and charge
description: Darcy-Weisbach friction loss dP = f*(L/D)*rho*v^2/2 (single phase) and Friedel or Muller-Steinhagen-Heck two-phase multipliers with quality-dependent properties; adiabatic, fully developed; composite Pipe class chains straight sections and elbows and sums the refrigerant charge.
notes: difficulty=easy; thin wrapper over correlations/pressure_drop/pipe_DP.py (see that row). reference results: no.

title: Pipe elbow - local pressure loss (Idelchik), single and two-phase
description: Local loss coefficient zeta_tot of curved bends (Idelchik: Reynolds-regime corrections, roughness factor CF_fri) and pressure drop; two-phase via homogeneous density. Adiabatic, constant diameter, no elevation change.
notes: difficulty=easy; explicit coefficients in a FUNCTION. reference results: no.

title: Parabolic trough collector - semi-empirical model (Dickes-Lemort-Quoilin), discretised along the absorber
description: Absorber divided into n_disc elements; per element Q_abs = DNI*cos(theta)*L_disc*W*eta_coll(DNI, T-T_amb) (collector-efficiency map of the Soponova MicroCSP collector) and enthalpy marching h[i+1] = h[i] + Q/m_dot; the repo also provides the 10-coefficient semi-empirical heat-loss correlation (heat_losses/Q_dot_abs) from Dickes, Lemort & Quoilin, but solve() currently uses the efficiency map (the correlation methods are defined and unused). Outputs outlet enthalpy and absorbed power.
notes: difficulty=easy; explicit marching (or implicit with T_mean) over a fixed number of cells -> DUPLICATE; the efficiency map is a 6x17 table (RectBivariateSpline) -> 2D lookup. reference results: no stored outputs (example runs a discretisation-convergence study, 1-50 cells, 10 collectors in series, 0.6 kg/s water at 100 C, 900 W/m2, 10 deg incidence); model PDF docs/source/_static/pdf_files/ReadTheDocs_PTcollector.pdf; the original correlation is by S. Quoilin et al. (https://hdl.handle.net/2268/182680) so the original can serve as cross-check. gap: solar-thermal collector models.

title: Latent (PCM) storage heat exchanger - isothermal storage side with constant pinch
description: Working fluid exchanging heat with an isothermal PCM store at its melting temperature T_sto (default: triple point of the storage material, 1 atm). Discharge branch (T_su <= T_sto): exit T_ex = T_sto - Pinch, saturation at T_sat = T_ex - Delta_T_sh_sc, heat = sensible + latent + superheating; charge branch (T_su > T_sto): T_ex = T_sto + Pinch, condensation at T_sat = T_ex + Delta_T_sh_sc. Saturation pressure follows directly from T_sat.
fluids: any (CoolProp) working fluid; PCM only as an isothermal reservoir
notes: difficulty=easy; fully explicit (no iteration): two regimes selected by an IF on T_su vs T_sto, three heat terms from saturation enthalpies; docstring is a copy of the HX-constant-pinch text and the 'pinch cannot be satisfied' branches simply return. reference results: no. overlap: CoolSolve examples/zorlu_heat_pump.eescode already contains a PCM-storage heat pump (EES translation of the Zorlu study). Used in the transcritical CO2 cycle examples.

title: Isothermal storage tank - charge/discharge time stepping (state of charge)
description: Explicit Euler update of tank filling ratio FR and mixed enthalpy over a time step DT for charge or discharge mode; SOC from enthalpy and density.
notes: difficulty=medium; maps to INTEGRAL (two states: volume and enthalpy). code appears unfinished (undefined attributes such as self.ex.mdot, min(0,.) in discharge, copy-pasted HX docstring) - treat as a sketch. reference results: no.

title: Mixer - steady adiabatic mixing of n streams
description: Mass balance and enthalpy balance for n inlets of the same fluid; inlet pressures must agree within a tolerance (100 Pa); outlet at mean pressure.
authors: Basile Chaudoir; Marie Peeters; Elise Neven
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no. trivial.

title: Splitter - fixed mass-flow fractions, unchanged state
description: Divides the inlet mass flow into outlets with given fractions; P, h and composition unchanged.
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no. trivial.

title: Liquid-vapour separator (flash tank) - saturated outlets from inlet quality
description: Splits a two-phase inlet into saturated liquid and saturated vapour lines using inlet quality x_su; no pressure drop, no heat loss, geometry-free.
authors: Samuel Gendebien; Basile Chaudoir; Elise Neven
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no. used in the CO2 flash-tank heat-pump architectures.

title: Gas-liquid drum separator - droplet terminal velocity and grade efficiency
description: Gravity separator model: droplet size distribution, terminal velocity (iterative drag), d50, overall efficiency of a vertical drum for a gas stream carrying oil droplets; viscosity from ASTM D341 Walther fit.
notes: difficulty=hard; equipment-sizing model (not a thermodynamic component), docstrings empty, heavy plotting. reference results: no. low relevance for a thermodynamic model library.

title: Oil separator (cyclone, Muschelknautz method) - separation efficiency
description: Muschelknautz cyclone separation model for oil-laden refrigerant/gas flow: inlet velocities, limit loading, d50 cut size, droplet distribution, overall and grade efficiency, experimental comparison scripts.
notes: difficulty=hard; 1100 lines of equipment-specific correlations and plotting, docstrings empty. reference results: no (experimental comparison data embedded). not a priority.

title: Pressure drop in pipes - friction factors (Churchill, Swamee-Jain, Konakov, Petukhov, Haaland, Cheng CO2) and two-phase (Muller-Steinhagen-Heck, Friedel, Choi) incl. acceleration and gravity
description: 14 functions: six Darcy friction-factor correlations, single-phase pipe dP, three two-phase frictional multipliers/dP models, and acceleration + gravity terms with a dispatcher for total two-phase dP.
authors: Basile Chaudoir; Elise Neven; Samuel Gendebien
notes: difficulty=easy; pure algebra per function (FUNCTION in CoolSolve), property calls via CoolProp. reference results: no tests; validate against textbook/EES DarcyFriction values and the original papers (Churchill 1977, Swamee-Jain 1976, Friedel 1979, Muller-Steinhagen & Heck 1986). gap: only Colebrook single-phase exists in CoolSolve examples/pressuredrop.eescode; two-phase multipliers are missing.

title: Local losses in bends - Idelchik coefficients (single/two-phase)
description: Reynolds-regime transition, Idelchik coefficients, roughness correction and total zeta for curved bends; pressure_drop_curved_elbow().
notes: difficulty=easy; explicit coefficients. reference results: no. Reference: Idelchik, Handbook of Hydraulic Resistance. See also component row for the elbow.

title: Shell-side pressure drop - Kern, Donohue, Bell-Delaware
description: Shell-side flow areas, hydraulic diameter and pressure-drop correlations for baffled shell-and-tube exchangers (Kern, Donohue, Bell-Delaware correction factors).
notes: difficulty=medium; many geometry-dependent correction factors (tables/interpolations). reference results: no (cheguide.com worked example is cited as reference).

title: Plate heat exchanger pressure drop - Han et al. (chevron angle)
description: Single correlation han_BPHEX_DP for condensation/evaporation friction in brazed plate HX as function of chevron angle (Kim/Han 2003).
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no.

title: Finned-tube air-side pressure drop
description: DP_tube_and_fins: air-side pressure drop across transversely finned tube banks.
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no (Handbook for transversely finned tube heat exchanger design is the source).

title: Void-fraction correlations (homogeneous, Zivi, Fauske, Premoli, Lockhart-Martinelli, Hughmark, Graham, Armand-Treschev, Bankoff, Rouhani-Axelsson, Dix, Woldesemayat-Ghajar, Cioncolini-Thome)
description: Thirteen void-fraction models (slip-ratio, K-epsilon and drift-flux families) plus a dispatcher compute_void_fraction() for refrigerant/ORC two-phase flow; used for charge estimation in heat exchangers and pipes.
notes: difficulty=easy; each model is a short algebraic FUNCTION (Hughmark needs a small implicit equation). reference results: no tests (void_fraction_example.py plots the models); cross-check against the original papers/ACHP. gap: only a single void-fraction model exists in the user's EES bank (ORC simple model with void fraction.EES); this family fills it.

title: In-tube heat transfer coefficients - single-phase (Gnielinski, Dittus-Boelter), condensation (Thome), flow boiling (Steiner-Taborek, Gungor-Winterton, Choi), pool/film boiling, sCO2 (Cheng, Meshram, Liu)
description: 15 functions for forced convection, horizontal-tube condensation and boiling, pool/film boiling curve, and supercritical CO2 cooling correlations (Liu, Cheng, Meshram).
authors: Basile Chaudoir; Elise Neven; Samuel Gendebien
notes: difficulty=medium; algebraic but property-heavy (wall properties, pseudo-critical handling for sCO2, boiling curve with implicit pieces). reference results: no tests; references in docstrings (Incropera, Wolverine Tube data book, VDI Heat Atlas, Liu et al. 2014/2024, Cheng, Meshram). Contains code adapted from Van Long Le's heat-pipe code (see heat-pipe row). EES covers Gnielinski/Dittus-Boelter natively; flow-boiling/condensation and sCO2 sets are the gap.

title: Plate heat exchanger heat transfer coefficients (Martin/Holger VDI, Muley-Manglik, Thonon, Kumar, Amalfi, Han boiling/condensation, Shah condensation, Yan)
description: 14 correlations for single-phase, boiling and condensation in chevron plate heat exchangers plus a water-side calibrated correlation (65 deg chevron).
notes: difficulty=easy-medium; algebraic FUNCTIONs with geometry arguments (chevron angle, hydraulic diameter, enlargement factor). reference results: no tests. plate_htc_old.py is an older variant (see duplicate group). Sources: Hofmann/Kind/Martin (VDI Atlas), Han et al., Amalfi et al., Shah 2021. gap: plate-HX correlation set absent from CoolSolve examples (plate_heat_exchanger_SB080104.EES exists in the user's EES bank for comparison).

title: Plate heat exchanger heat transfer coefficients - older version
description: Earlier version of plate_htc.py (12 functions incl. simple_plate_HTC, han_BPHEX_DP).
notes: difficulty=easy; superseded by plate_htc.py - use that one. reference results: no.

title: Shell-side heat transfer coefficient - Kern, Donohue, Bell-Delaware
description: Shell-side crossflow areas, Kern and Donohue HTC and the Bell-Delaware method with its correction factors (J_c, J_l, J_b, J_s, J_r).
notes: difficulty=medium; many correction-factor tables. reference results: no (Kern, Process Heat Transfer; cheguide worked example).

title: External flow over tube banks - HTC and DP (inline/staggered), film condensation and boiling on tubes
description: Euler-number based pressure drop, Nusselt for inline/staggered banks (Incropera/Zukauskas type), external film condensation (Nusselt-type) and boiling on tube bundles.
notes: difficulty=medium; reference results: no (Incropera, Beale/Thermopedia).

title: Finned-tube air-side heat transfer coefficient and fin efficiency (annular/square fins)
description: htc_tube_and_fins (annular, square variants) and rectangular straight-fin efficiency after the Handbook for Transversely Finned Tube Heat Exchanger Design.
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no.

title: Printed-circuit heat exchanger (PCHE) HTC - Lee and generic channel types
description: PCHE_conv (straight/zigzag/wavy/airfoil channels) and PCHE_Lee correlations for sCO2 PCHEs.
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no (refs: Meshram 2016; 'Design and dynamic modeling of PCHE for sCO2 Brayton cycles' 2018).

title: Simple overall-U / HTC correlations (Gnielinski-calibrated, Dittus-Boelter, Cooper, Thonon)
description: Four small calibrated HTC helper functions used by early moving-boundary models.
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no. superseded by pipe_htc.py/plate_htc.py.

title: HX thermal relations - eps-NTU for flow arrangements, LMTD correction factor F (shell & tube), UA sizing from profiles
description: e_NTU (counter, parallel, crossflow mixed/unmixed approximation, shell&tube 1-2 and n passes), f_lmtd2/F_shell_and_tube (LMTD and F-factor, multipass), find_UA/basic_sizing_UA.
notes: difficulty=easy; closed-form relations (counterflow formula is singular at C_r=1; the crossflow relation is the usual approximation). reference results: indirect - TESPy test_ntu_heat_exchanger.py cross-validates the same relations against the 'ht' library and textbook values. overlap: CoolSolve examples/exchangers1-3 already use eps-NTU (counter, crossflow, shell&tube).

title: Moving-boundary helpers - two-phase boundaries under pressure drop, dry-out incipience (Kim)
description: find_2P_boundaries finds saturated liquid/vapour pressures and enthalpies when pressure drops linearly with enthalpy (after R. Dickes); kim_dry_out_incipience gives dry-out quality.
notes: difficulty=medium; two scalar minimisations -> two implicit equations (P_sat,l and P_sat,v). reference results: no. Attribution: ported from Rdickes (R. Dickes) / jvega.

title: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger cost correlations (CAPEX/OPEX, Hall, Caputo manufacturing cost, Krishna)
description: total_STHE_cost: CAPEX (Hall correlation a1+a2*A^a3), pumping OPEX, discounted total; manufacturing-cost model of Caputo, Pelagagge & Salini; CPI/EURUSD updating.
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no. economics, not thermodynamics; keep for techno-economic extensions.

title: Heat-pipe/thermosyphon HTC set - radiative and tube-bank external HTC, pool/film boiling, ESDU-type limits
description: External flow over inline/staggered tube banks, radiative HTC for flue gas, pool boiling, film boiling, boiling curve, condensation; support for the thermosyphon HX model.
notes: difficulty=medium; near-duplicate copy lives in sizing/heat_exchanger/heat_pipe_HTX/modules/HP_h_coeffs.py. PROVENANCE: docstrings cite 'Van Long Le - Heat Pipe Code' (third-party origin, licence not stated) - clarify before reuse. reference results: no.

title: Heat-pipe/thermosyphon HTC set - sizing-module copy
description: Older/near-duplicate copy of correlations/heat_pipe/HP_h_coeffs.py used by the heat-pipe sizing scripts.
notes: difficulty=medium; duplicate of the representative row - use correlations/heat_pipe/HP_h_coeffs.py.

title: Steel pipe/tube maximum allowable pressure (ASME B31 / BPV allowable stress vs temperature)
description: P_max_adm and Internal_Max_P_carbon_steel: allowable pressure from tube diameter, thickness and wall temperature using tabulated allowable stress (ASME).
notes: difficulty=easy; reference results: no. also in toolbox/piping/pipe_thickness.py and sizing/.../modules/P_max_steel_pipes.py (variants).

title: Thermal conductivity of R1233zd(E) (Perkins & Huber correlation)
description: conducticity_R1233zd(T,P): dedicated conductivity correlation because the fluid has no thermal-conductivity model in CoolProp (verified with CoolProp 7.2.0: PropsSI('L',...,'R1233zd(E)') raises 'not available').
notes: difficulty=easy; one explicit FUNCTION. reference results: no (Perkins & Huber published coefficients). high leverage: needed for any heat-transfer model with R1233zd(E) (ORC working fluid used in the user's models). Attribution: R. A. Perkins & M. L. Huber.

title: Pseudo-critical temperature and pseudo-boiling bounds (general fluids, CO2)
description: pseudo_critical_temperature (maximum cp line), pseudo_boiling_bounds (pseudo-boiling transition bounds) and CO2 correlation of pseudo-critical temperature vs pressure.
notes: difficulty=medium; the general version searches for the cp maximum (iterative) - use the CO2 correlation as FUNCTION. reference results: no (refs: 'Latent heat of supercritical fluids' 2019; sCO2 property papers).

title: Parabolic-trough heat-loss correlation (Dickes, Lemort, Quoilin) - 10-coefficient semi-empirical form
description: heat_losses = a0 + a1*dT + a2*dT^2 + DNI*cos(theta)*(a3*T^2 + a4*sqrt(v)) + a5*T^3 + a6*v + a7*v*dT + a8*sqrt(v) + a9*sqrt(v)*dT [W/m of collector]; Q_dot_abs gives absorbed power from optical efficiency chain; coefficients for the Soponova MicroCSP collector.
notes: difficulty=easy; one explicit FUNCTION. reference results: coefficient set a[0..9] = [20.62, -0.2893, 1.472e-3, 2.240e-8, 1.198e-3, 1.403e-6, 1.045, -3.043e-2, -8.481, 0.2073] for Soponova MicroCSP (toolbox/geometries/solar/parabolictrough_geometry.py); no tests. Source paper authored by S. Quoilin (https://hdl.handle.net/2268/182680) - authors of CoolSolve can verify directly.

title: Axial turbine loss models - Aungier (profile, secondary, clearance...) and Balje-Binsley/Kacker-Okapuu
description: profile_losses, secondary_losses, aungier_loss_model for axial turbine blade rows (angles, solidity, Mach/Reynolds corrections); pressure_loss_model.py holds Balje-Binsley profile and Kacker-Okapuu secondary loss correlations.
notes: difficulty=hard; long angle-based correlation chains with many geometry inputs; no validation data in repo. reference results: no.

title: Radial compressor and radial turbine loss models (rotor/stator)
description: Rotor incidence, friction, blade loading, clearance, mixing, disc-friction, recirculation and stator losses for centrifugal compressors; nozzle, rotor incidence/passage/clearance/trailing-edge and windage losses for radial turbines.
notes: difficulty=hard; geometry-heavy, unvalidated in repo. reference results: no.

title: 0D turbomachinery correlations - Cordier line and pump efficiency estimation
description: cordier_line (specific diameter vs specific speed) and pump_efficiency_0D_estimation(omega_s, Q) by 2D interpolation; basis of the 0D sizing scripts.
notes: difficulty=easy; two lookup tables; reference results: no (Cordier diagram data embedded).

title: Legacy fin-and-tube evaporator/condenser correlation script (Kays & London, McQuiston)
description: Single-phase and two-phase in-tube HTC/pressure drop for fin-and-tube coils plus air-side HTC, Kays & London air pressure drop, overall surface efficiency; script-style with defaults.
notes: difficulty=medium; script, not library-quality; superseded by fins_htc.py/pipe_htc.py. reference results: no.

title: Heat pump cycle - constant-eta compressor, constant-pinch condenser/evaporator, isenthalpic valve (+ IHX variant)
description: basic_HP ('Example' case): propane heat pump, condenser heats water entering at 60 C (2 kg/s), evaporator cooled by water at 20 C (10 kg/s), pinch 3 K, superheat/subcooling 3 K, eta_is=0.7, refrigerant flow imposed at 0.1 kg/s; basic_IHX_HP ('IHX' case, Zorlu geothermal data): cyclopentane heat pump with internal heat exchanger (eff 0.8), evaporator water 113.1 C/500 kg/s, condenser water 141 C/10 000 kg/s, 34.51 kg/s refrigerant. Solved with CircuitFPI (Wegstein) on pressure/enthalpy residuals.
notes: difficulty=easy-medium; once HexCstPinch/HexCstEff are translated the cycle is ~15 state-point equations; iteration variables (P_low,P_high) become unknowns closed by the pinch equations. reference results: no stored numbers (script prints converged pressures); overlap: CoolSolve refrigeration1-3 and zorlu_heat_pump.eescode (EES translation of the Zorlu study) - compare results. Exact case-variant duplicate: FPI_HeatPump_example.py; solver variant: it_HeatPump_example.py (IterativeCircuit).

title: Recuperated + preheated ORC (cyclopentane, Zorlu geothermal case) - constant-eta machines, pinch evaporator/condenser
description: preheated_rec_orc: cyclopentane ORC with recuperator (eff 0.8) and a preheater, hot source water 141 C/10 bar (10 000 kg/s emulating a PCM store), cooling water 24 C/900 kg/s, m_dot=34.51 kg/s, eta_pp=0.7, eta_exp=0.8, PP=5 K, SH=3 K, SC=3 K. Iteration variables: expander-outlet/condenser pressure link and pump-outlet/evaporator pressure link.
notes: difficulty=easy-medium; closed set of constant-eta/pinch blocks -> simultaneous equations with P_high/P_low unknowns. reference results: no stored numbers. CAUTION: in the Zorlu main block the preheater source is built from the cold-source values (T_CS, p_CS, m_dot_CS) although T_PRE=113.1 C, p_PRE and m_dot_PRE are defined - apparent bug, so the example's preheater duty is not meaningful as is. overlap: CoolSolve orc_simple/orc_complex/orc_extraction (generic) - novelty is the pinch-based design formulation with preheater. Solver variant: it_orc_example.py.

title: Off-design ORC with semi-empirical scroll expander, moving-boundary plate heat exchangers and pump curves (R1233zd(E))
description: off_design_orc: R1233zd(E) ORC (water source 70 C/3 kg/s, sink 10 C/2 kg/s) with ExpanderSE (calibrated, P_M mode), two SWEP P200THx140 plate HX models solved with the charge-sensitive moving-boundary model (correlations: Martin-Holger, Amalfi, Shah), PumpCurveSimilarity (2900 rpm rated curves) and an imposed 7 K subcooling.
notes: difficulty=hard; combines three level-3/4 components (see their rows); the full model needs plate geometry, HTC/DP correlations and the MB core as FUNCTIONs. reference results: no stored numbers (research model, validated against ULiege test-rig data in the originating thesis, not in repo). research-grade flagship once the components exist.

title: Transcritical CO2 power cycles - basic, recuperated, recompression (one/two recuperators) with off-design cases
description: basic_CO2_TC, REC_CO2_TC, Recomp_CO2_TC, Recomp_CO2_TC_1_recup: pump/expander/gas heater (HexCstEffDisc)/condenser (HexCstPinch)/recuperators (HexCstEffDisc, min pinch)/splitter-mixer; example: 350 C water heat source, 10 C cooling water, 30 kg/s CO2, 150 bar, eta_pp 0.9, eta_cp 0.8, eta_exp 0.9, eta_gh 0.95, eta_rec 0.9; parametric maps over split fraction and high pressure; includes sensitivity and off-design (lines 868+).
notes: difficulty=medium; algebraic cycle architectures; discretised pinch-limited HX (see hex_csteff_disc row); recompression split fraction = free unknown/spec. reference results: no stored numbers; for a validated sCO2 recompression benchmark see the TESPy inventory (Penkuhn & Tsatsaronis 2018). overlap: CoolSolve orc_co2.eescode (CO2 ORC with polynomial compressor map).

title: Transcritical CO2 heat pump architectures - basic, expander, IHX, IHX+expander, flash-tank with parallel or series compression
description: basic_CO2_HP, Exp_CO2_HP, IHX_CO2_HP, IHX_EXP_CO2_HP, Flash_CO2_HP_Parallel_CP, Flash_CO2_HP_Series_CP: constant-eta compressors/expander, effectiveness gas cooler, pinch evaporator, isenthalpic valves, LV separator and mixer; boundary conditions: water gas-cooler load and low-temperature source.
notes: difficulty=medium; algebraic cycles; high-pressure optimum is a free parameter (original code optimises with PSO - here only parametric studies are possible). reference results: no. Exact duplicate: FPI_TC_HeatPump_example.py (case-variant file name; breaks on case-insensitive file systems).

title: Propane heat pump with pipe model (pressure drops and refrigerant charge in the connecting pipes)
description: Basic pinch-based HP (eta_is=0.8, PP=3 K, SH=SC=3 K) in which suction/discharge/liquid lines are modelled with the Pipe component (straight sections + elbows, Friedel/MSH dP); two routing methods (method1/method2).
notes: difficulty=medium; adds pipe dP equations to the basic HP; reference results: no.

title: Heat pump cycles (basic and IHX) solved with the IterativeCircuit solver - solver variant of fpi_HeatPump_example.py
description: Same propane/cyclopentane heat-pump cycles as fpi_HeatPump_example.py but with the newer IterativeCircuit (fsolve/root on declared iteration variables) instead of CircuitFPI.
notes: difficulty=easy-medium; duplicate of the representative row (only the Python solver differs).

title: ORC examples (preheated recuperated ORC and off-design scroll-expander ORC) solved with IterativeCircuit - solver variant
description: Same two ORC studies as fpi_orc_example.py (Zorlu cyclopentane ORC; R1233zd(E) off-design ORC with ExpanderSE, MB plate HX and pump curves) using IterativeCircuit.
notes: difficulty=medium; duplicate of the two fpi_orc_example.py rows (solver variant); same Zorlu preheater-source inconsistency in the main block.

title: PSO optimisation of CO2 transcritical Rankine/recompression cycles and CO2 heat pumps
description: Particle-swarm (pyswarms, joblib parallel) over P_high, m_dot and heat-source factor for the transcritical CO2 cycle architectures; penalty handling and warm start; companion script for CO2 heat pumps.
notes: difficulty=infeasible; requires a global optimiser and repeated cycle solves (CoolSolve has no optimisation algorithm yet). The underlying cycle models are covered by the transcritical CO2 cycle rows - use parametric studies instead. reference results: no.

title: Techno-economic design of CO2 Rankine cycles (turbine, HX, pump sizing + PSO + cost per kW)
description: Couples cycle simulation with mean-line turbine sizing, PCHE and shell-and-tube sizing, radial pump design and cost correlations in a PSO loop to minimise EUR/kW.
notes: difficulty=infeasible; multi-model sizing + PSO. reference results: no.

title: 0D turbomachinery sizing - specific speed / Cordier line (turbine, compressor, pump, radial pump)
description: turbine_0D_design, compressor_0D_design, pump_0D_design, radial pump design: specific speed, machine type (radial/Francis/mixed/axial), Cordier specific diameter, diameter and efficiency estimate.
notes: difficulty=easy; explicit formulas + Cordier table. reference results: no. useful as teaching add-on to turbomachinery models.

title: Axial turbine 1D mean-line design (Aungier loss model) and eta-per-row design
description: Design of multi-stage axial turbines by mean-line analysis with Aungier loss model or constant row efficiencies; optimisation (SciPy/PSO) over stage loading, flow coefficient etc.; ISRE 3D variant in sizing_3D.
notes: difficulty=hard; optimisation-driven design loops (1800 lines); the analysis core duplicates turbine_mean_line_Aungier.py. reference results: no.

title: Radial turbine 1D mean-line design (loss model, eta-per-row, parallel PSO)
description: Radial-inflow turbine design with nozzle/rotor loss models; three variants (eta-row, loss model, parallel PSO).
notes: difficulty=hard; optimisation-driven. reference results: no.

title: Radial compressor 1D mean-line sizing; axial compressor 1D design (eta-row, loss model)
description: Mean-line sizing of radial and axial compressors with loss models and optimisation over geometry.
notes: difficulty=hard; optimisation-driven. reference results: no.

title: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger sizing by PSO (parallel version)
description: Particle-swarm search over discrete tube diameters, shell IDs, baffle spacing, length etc. with the moving-boundary S&T model and cost/DP objectives.
notes: difficulty=infeasible; discrete-variable global optimisation. reference results: no. Near-duplicate of shell_and_tube_sizing_PSO.py (2062 vs 2134 lines).

title: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger sizing by PSO (serial version)
description: Serial predecessor of shell_and_tube_sizing_PSO_parallel.py.
notes: difficulty=infeasible; duplicate of the parallel version.

title: Printed-circuit heat exchanger sizing by PSO
description: PSO design of PCHE recuperators for sCO2 cycles using the charge-sensitive moving-boundary model, plate thickness (ASME) and cost (CPI-adjusted) models.
notes: difficulty=infeasible; global optimiser. reference results: no.

title: Plate heat exchanger ORC condenser/evaporator - legacy three-zone discretised models (R1233zd(E))
description: Script-style plate HX model for ORC condenser (PHX_CD_ORC) and evaporator (PHX_EV_ORC): geometry of the brazed plate HX, three zones (sc/tp/sh) solved with scipy root, correlations from VDI/Kakac/ACHP, validation noted against 'ELISE' test-rig data (history log in the file header).
notes: difficulty=medium; legacy scripts depend on a missing BaseClases package (HTCorrelation, Classes, VoidFraction) so they are not runnable as-is; superseded by hex_MB_charge_sensitive.py. reference results: no stored numbers (validation claimed in file header only).

title: Heat-pipe heat exchanger bank sizing sweep (thermosyphon tube model)
description: Parameter sweep over tube diameter, length, filling ratio and tube-matrix arrangement with the thermosyphon tube model and operating limits; post-processing and encoding for optimisation.
notes: difficulty=hard; sweep/optimisation script around the thermosyphon model. reference results: no.

title: Pressurised hot-water storage vessel design (ASME wall thickness, cost, optimisation)
description: Vessel geometry optimisation: required wall thickness from allowable stress (BPVC 2007), material properties and cost (Towler & Sinnott), minimise cost with scipy/PSO.
notes: difficulty=infeasible; mechanical/cost design with optimiser, not thermodynamic. reference results: no.
